surprise-1792135780020.title: A Little World for Your Partner ♡
surprise-1792135780020.welcomeSubtitle: Turn your little moments into a big love story. A special continuous surprise prepared with all my love.

openingChapter.subtitle: I made a little something just for you. Something that says all the things I sometimes forget to say out loud.
openingChapter.tinyNote: Psst... this is only for you.

habitCards.category: Something you do when you're excited
habitCards.habitText: The way you get all excited over the smallest things—like finding a cute cafe or seeing a cat—is honestly the cutest thing ever.
You try so hard to look angry at me, but the second your lips twitch into a smile, your whole villain arc is ruined.

habitCards.category: A little habit I secretly love
habitCards.habitText: How you claim my oversized hoodies are 'more comfortable' when we both know you just like smelling like me.

habitCards.category: Something you think I don't notice
habitCards.habitText: I always catch you stealing glances when you think I'm focused on driving or working. You look away so fast, it's adorable.
habitCards.reactionNote: I was not looking! (Okay maybe a little) 💗

habitCards.category: A tiny thing that reminds me of you
habitCards.habitText: 3:00 AM snack debates. Whenever I see midnight ramen or strawberry milk, I instantly think of you.

habitCards.category: A thing you do when you're nervous
habitCards.habitText: Spinning your ring around your finger three times whenever you're waiting for something important. I'm always right here beside you.

habitCards.whatYouDo: Covering your mouth when you giggle
habitCards.habitText: You think nobody notices, but it is the cutest thing in the world.

secretUnlock.clue: The 5-letter nickname I call you when you're being dramatic and soft.
secretUnlock.hint: Starts with 'c', ends with 'e', rhymes with beauty! ♡
wrongBanter: Aww... Itna bhi nahi pata mujhe? 🥺 Try again na...
Galat hai! 😭 Ek aur chance... Main itni jaldi nahi khulne wali!
Nice try cutie! 🙈 But that's not our secret code.
Are you sure you're my person? 👀 Think harder, my love!
Wrong answer! 😤 Ek cup coffee peeke aao fir try karo 💕
Close, but no cuddle! One more try?
secretUnlock.rewardMessage: I knew you'd remember, Your Partner! You are the sweetest part of my everyday life. Whether we're bantering over silly inside jokes or sitting in quiet comfort, there's nobody else I'd rather share this little world with. Happy surprises, today and always. ♡

deluluStory.realWorldClosingNote: Okay, our delulu universe ends here. But in this universe, I'm still choosing you, Rhea. Every single day. 💗

ch1.title: The Project Assignment
ch1.sceneText: The university auditorium buzzes as Professor Sharma announces semester partners. 'You and Your Partner—Room 402 project.' An audible gasp ripples through the room. You both have been competing for the #1 GPA all year. Your Partner crosses her arms, raising an eyebrow with that signature smirk.

choices.label: Tease her about carrying the project
Offer to buy coffee before arguing

ch2_tease.title: Library Standoff
ch2_tease.sceneText: In the 4th floor library corner, Your Partner slides her research notes across the mahogany table. 'Don't drool, Smarty, these took three hours.' Suddenly she notices your sticky note citing our famous inside joke: 'delulu 3 AM ramen debates'. She lets out that tippy-tappy excited hand dance she thinks nobody notices.

choices.label: Reach across and slide her a hot chocolate
Challenge her to a 10-minute quiz race

ch2_smug.title: Under the Library Lights
ch2_smug.sceneText: Rain taps against the arched library glass. You pretend to read page 342, but every time Your Partner tucks her hair behind her ear, focus evaporates. 'Stop staring, rival,' she whispers without looking up. 'You're losing precious studying seconds.' But her cheeks are glowing soft blush pink.

choices.label: Admit you'd rather lose if it means looking at her
Share your oversized hoodie because she's shivering

ch2_coffee.title: The Caramel Peace Treaty
ch2_coffee.sceneText: You hand her a warm cup with a tiny doodle on the sleeve. Your Partner tries to look serious, but the moment she sips it, her shoulders drop. 'Fine. Ceasefire for twenty minutes,' she decrees. 'Only because you remembered extra caramel.'

choices.label: Walk her home under one shared umbrella

ch3_ending_soft.title: Ending A — Beyond the Grade Curve
ch3_ending_soft.sceneText: Midnight arrives. The library is empty except for you two under the amber lamp. Your Partner closes her binder and looks right into your eyes. 'I don't think I care about being #1 anymore,' she admits softly. 'Unless it's your #1.' You reach across the table, your fingers touching hers.

ch3_ending_rival.title: Ending B — The Tiebreaker Kiss
ch3_ending_rival.sceneText: The quiz ends in a dead tie. Your Partner gasps playfully. 'No way! Rematch right now!' But as she leans across the desk to grab the stopwatch, her eyes lock onto yours. The competition vanishes into thin air. Neither of you moves away.

ch3_ending_hoodie.title: Ending C — Officially Confiscated
ch3_ending_hoodie.sceneText: Swallowed inside your grey oversized hoodie, Your Partner smiles that radiant, genuine smile you fell for. 'You're never getting this hoodie back, by the way,' she announces proudly. You just smile back. 'Keep it. It was made for you anyway.'

loveLoop.promptQuestion: Now tell me Rhea... What's one tiny thing I do that makes you smile? 💗

littleLore.title: Our first call
littleLore.content: We said we'd talk for 15 minutes because we were both 'so busy'. We ended up staying on the phone until 4:32 AM talking about alien conspiracy theories and childhood snacks.

littleLore.title: That cafe date
littleLore.content: Spilled caramel macchiato on the menu because I was laughing too hard at your impression of our professor. You gave me your napkin with a tiny heart drawn on the corner.

littleLore.title: You in my hoodie
littleLore.content: The grey oversized Nike hoodie was officially confiscated. I don't think I'm ever getting it back, but honestly you look 1000x cuter in it anyway.

littleLore.title: Our goofy pics
littleLore.content: That photobooth strip where we tried to take aesthetic couple photos but ended up making double-chin frog faces in the last two frames. The best ones on my lock screen.

littleLore.title: Playlist we both love
littleLore.content: The 38-song collaborative playlist titled 'delulu hours only'. Track 14 has our secret code hidden in the song title initials.

littleLore.title: Notes to each other
littleLore.content: Little sticky notes stuck inside textbooks and laptop lids. 'Drink water cutie' and 'Go crush this presentation!'

openWhenLetters.title: Open when you miss me
openWhenLetters.message: Hey love. Even when we're miles apart or just separated by a long day, there is a piece of my heart that is permanently right beside you. Close your eyes, take a deep breath, and feel my biggest, tightest hug. I'm already counting down the minutes until I see you next. 💗

openWhenLetters.title: Open when you're stressed about exams
openWhenLetters.message: Put your pen down for ten seconds and unclench your jaw. You've worked so hard for this, and your brain is full of magic. No single exam or grade defines who you are or how proud I am of you. Drink some water, take a breath, and go show them what you're made of! 🌟

openWhenLetters.title: Open when you need a smile
openWhenLetters.message: Emergency notification: you have officially been designated the cutest person on this planet. It is mandatory for you to smile right this second. Remember that time you laughed so hard you snorted? Yeah. That's my absolute favorite sound in the whole universe. ♡

openWhenLetters.title: Open when you're proud of yourself
openWhenLetters.message: I KNEW YOU COULD DO IT! 🎉 I am standing on the virtual rooftop shouting how incredible you are. Take this moment to soak it all in. You earned this win, and nobody deserves to celebrate more than you. Next treat is 100% on me!

openWhenLetters.title: Open when you're having a bad day
openWhenLetters.message: Bad days don't get to win. You don't have to be strong or cheerful right now. It's totally okay to crawl into bed, wrap yourself like a burrito, and be mad at the world. Tomorrow is a brand new blank page. I'm right here with you, always. 💗

openWhenLetters.title: Open when you can't sleep
openWhenLetters.message: Late night thoughts keeping you up? Imagine us sitting on a quiet balcony together watching the stars. No rush, no worries, just the gentle breeze and soft music. Let your shoulders drop. Sweet dreams, my favorite human. 🌙

openWhenLetters.title: Open when you need a reminder you're loved
openWhenLetters.message: Just in case you forgot: you are deeply, genuinely, unconditionally loved. Not just for your best days, but for every silly, tired, quiet, and imperfect moment in between. You are my home. ♡

finalReveal.heading: To My Favorite Person, Rhea
finalReveal.message:
Hey Your Partner,

I made this little world just for you, because sometimes a standard message doesn't feel like enough.

I hope every little habit card, every silly question, every secret code, and every alternate universe scene reminds you of one simple truth:

You are appreciated. You are important. And you deserve to feel loved, not just today, but in all the ordinary moments in between.

Thank you for being you. Always.
finalReveal.quote: You're my favorite notification, my favorite hello, and my favorite kind of forever. ♡
